messages:
kai_ops: During the leadership demo there was a brief 2s video freeze at ~16:05 and captions drifted out. Live stream stayed up. Anyone seeing recorder gaps? @nina?

nina: Checking record03 now. OBS reported a GPU encoder spike; switched to software fallback and reduced output to 4mbps.

obs-bot: obs: switched encoder from NVENC to x264 (profile: veryfast) at 2026-03-23T16:05:12Z. Scene: backup-live-panel.

infra-bot: infra: node record03 showed high GPU utilization then recovered. No disk errors. Suggest keeping software encoder for remainder of session.

kai_ops: Good call. Can we mark the affected segment (16:04:50-16:05:10) and ensure transcript capture?

qa-lyn: I'll scrape the chat and Q&A sheet for missed questions in that window. Noted one question at ~16:05 "can you clarify roadmap prioritization". I'll add to follow-ups.

sam (CEO): Don't stop Q&A. Keep logging missed items; we'll answer the top ones at the end. Comms wants the transcript.

stream-monitor: monitor: brief spike in encoder CPU from 82%->98% at 16:05, AV sync delta +2.1s for ~30s, packet loss nominal. Captions fallback active.

nina: Spliced segment uploaded to s3://redwood-archives/allhands/record03/2026-03-23/ (partial marker for 16:04:50-16:05:10). Link (team-read).

kai_ops: Thanks. Action items: 1) postmortem draft (kai_ops) by EOD, 2) QA compile missed questions (qa-lyn) in 30m, 3) Infra to review encoder sizing on record03 (infra team). If anyone needs raw clips preserved, paste S3 paths here. :thumbsup:
